description: This file contains utility helper methods for working with entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functions for filtering, sorting, relating, and managing date-sensitive entity records, as well as generating URL paths and handling primary key mappings.

classes.name: EntityUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static helper methods for entity operations within the OFBiz framework, including filtering, sorting, relation retrieval, URL path generation, and date-based entity filtering.

methods.name: makeFields
methods.description: Creates a map of string keys to comparable, serializable values from a variable argument list, expecting alternating key-value pairs with the key as a string.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the first GenericValue from a collection or list if available.

methods.name: getOnly
methods.description: Returns the sole GenericValue from a collection or list, throwing an exception if more than one exists.

methods.name: getFilterByDateExpr
methods.description: Generates an EntityCondition to filter entities based on date fields, typically 'fromDate' and 'thruDate'.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters a list of dated entities to include only those active at the current or specified timestamp.

methods.name: isValueActive
methods.description: Checks if a given GenericValue is active at a specified timestamp based on date fields.

methods.name: filterByAnd
methods.description: Filters a list of entities to include only those matching all given field-value pairs.

methods.name: filterByOr
methods.description: Filters a list to include entities matching any of the provided conditions.

methods.name: localizedOrderBy
methods.description: Sorts a collection of entities based on specified fields with localization support.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Sorts a collection of entities based on provided order criteria.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related entities based on a relationship name, optional filter fields, and cache usage preference.

methods.name: filterByCondition
methods.description: Filters a list of entities to those matching a specified EntityCondition.

methods.name: filterOutByCondition
methods.description: Filters a list to exclude entities matching a specified EntityCondition.

methods.name: findDatedInclusionEntity
methods.description: Finds entities with date inclusion logic, considering the current timestamp.

methods.name: newDatedInclusionEntity
methods.description: Creates or updates a date-inclusive entity at the specified timestamp.

methods.name: delDatedInclusionEntity
methods.description: Marks a dated inclusion entity as ended at the given timestamp.

methods.name: getFieldListFromEntityList
methods.description: Extracts a list of field values from a list of entities, optionally ensuring distinctness.

methods.name: getFieldListFromEntityListIterator
methods.description: Extracts field values from an EntityListIterator, with optional distinct filtering.

methods.name: getSelectedFieldValueListFromEntityList
methods.description: Produces a list of entities with only the selected fields.

methods.name: isMultiTenantEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether multi-tenant support is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: getStartIndexFromViewIndex
methods.description: Calculates the start index for pagination based on view index and size.

methods.name: getPagedList
methods.description: Returns a paginated subset of entities from an EntityListIterator.

methods.name: entityToPath
methods.description: Generates URL path string for an entity based on its primary key fields.

methods.name: getPkValuesMapFromPath
methods.description: Parses a URL path to extract primary key values into a map.
